name: WildReceipt: In-the-Wild Receipt Information Extraction Dataset
description: WildReceipt is a benchmark dataset for key information extraction (KIE) from unconstrained in-the-wild receipt images, introduced alongside the Spatial Dual-Modality Graph Reasoning (SDMG-R) framework by SenseTime and supported in MMOCR. WildReceipt consists of 1,739 authentic photographed receipts collected under realistic mobile conditions (involving camera angle variations, wrinkles, uneven illumination, and diverse background clutter). The dataset contains approximately 50,000 text box annotations categorized into 25 semantic entity classes (and an ignore/background class), enabling benchmarking of both closed-set entity tagging and open-set generalized key information extraction.

license.name: Unspecified by Source
license.notes: MMOCR framework codebase is distributed under Apache 2.0, but MMOCR official dataset documentation explicitly records the WildReceipt dataset license as 'N/A'. The dataset was published by SenseTime (arXiv:2103.14470) without an independent open data license or commercial usage declaration. Commercial usability remains unverified.
